title: Register for an academic course
description: Use the published Student Registration workflow and confirm the final registration status.
descriptionAr: استخدم إجراءات تسجيل الطلبة المنشورة وتحقق من الحالة النهائية للتسجيل.
verificationNote: Use the current official page for portal labels, applicable term and eligibility. This checklist does not submit a request or verify your private university record. Published registration guide; actual eligibility and seats are checked in the university system.
verificationNoteAr: تحقق من المسميات والفصل والأهلية في الصفحة الرسمية الحالية. لا ترسل هذه القائمة الطلب ولا تتحقق من سجلك الجامعي الخاص.
scopeNote: Published registration guide; actual eligibility and seats are checked in the university system.

steps.title: Prepare
steps.instruction: Prepare: ask your advisor to set the Degree Works plan Active & Locked and review blocking holds.
steps.instructionAr: التحضير: اطلب تفعيل خطة Degree Works وقفلها Active & Locked وراجع قيود التسجيل.

steps.title: Open Student Registration
steps.instruction: Open Student Registration: UAEU website → Sign In → MyUAEU → eServices → Student → Student Registration; review Prepare for Registration.
steps.instructionAr: افتح تسجيل الطلبة: موقع الجامعة ← تسجيل الدخول ← MyUAEU ← eServices ← Student ← Student Registration، ثم راجع Prepare for Registration.

steps.title: Choose a section
steps.instruction: Choose a section: Register for Classes → intended term → Continue → Plans → View Sections → Add. Add leaves the selection Pending.
steps.instructionAr: اختر شعبة: Register for Classes ← الفصل المطلوب ← Continue ← Plans ← View Sections ← Add. تبقى الإضافة Pending في هذه المرحلة.

steps.title: Complete registration
steps.instruction: Complete registration: press Submit and verify Registered and Save Successful; resolve prerequisites, holds, capacity or time-conflict errors.
steps.instructionAr: أكمل التسجيل: اضغط Submit وتحقق من Registered وSave Successful، وعالج أخطاء المتطلبات أو القيود أو السعة أو التعارض.

sources.title: UAEU Course Registration Service Guide
sources.evidenceText: Official registration guide pages 2–4: advisor must set the Degree Works plan Active & Locked. Open UAEU website > Sign In > MyUAEU > eServices > Student > Student Registration. Check Prepare for Registration/holds. Choose Register for Classes, intended term, Continue, Plans, desired course, View Sections, then Add the section. Add produces Pending, not enrollment; press Submit and verify Registered/Save Successful. Full sections and time conflicts cause errors. Page 5: Closed Section means no seats; a CLOSED SECTION override may be requested, otherwise choose a course with space. Dropping: Action > Drop-Web > Submit. Page 7 says choose Plan, not manual CRN entry.
